اعتزلتم (form VIII)
# اِعْتَزَلْتُمْ (iʕtazaltum) /iʕ.ta.zal.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
# اُعْتُزِلْتُمْ (uʕtuziltum) /uʕ.tu.zil.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
